units.source_text: 如今这些画卷还保留在彩车上。

en.t: Even today, these picture scrolls are still preserved on the festival floats.

units.source_text: 都是些所谓舶来品，诸如中国织锦、巴黎葛布蓝织锦、毛织品、金线织花锦缎、葛丝等。

en.t: They are all so-called imported goods, such as Chinese brocade, Parisian Gobelin tapestry, woolen fabrics, brocade woven with gold thread, kudzu fiber, and the like.

units.source_text: 由于同外国贸易，在具有桃山时代风格的大花日本伞上，还增添了异国的美。

en.t: Through trade with foreign countries, an exotic beauty was added to the large floral Japanese parasols with their Momoyama-period style.
